description: Per-mission curated image URLs for JHU APL-led missions. JHU APL is prime contractor on DART, Parker, New Horizons, Dragonfly. Their galleries host higher-res masters of mission hardware + the canonical 'DART final frame' that the Wikimedia Commons mirror crops down.

dart._notes: Site is responsive (200 OK on health check 2026-06-17). Three slots to re-source from JHU APL: dart/02 (Dimorphos final frame), dart/04 (spacecraft hardware portrait), dart/05 (post-impact plume). Need WebFetch of the gallery page to extract real image URLs; slots populated once URLs verified.

parker-solar-probe._notes: Default gallery path (parkersolarprobe.jhuapl.edu/Gallery/) returns 404 — URL pattern changed. Need to find current gallery path before populating. Parker Solar Probe was sourced via NASA images-api in broader-NASA pass (3/5 NASA, 2/5 Commons), so this is a future-quality-upgrade slot, not a gap.

new-horizons._notes: Currently sourced via NASA / Commons. JHU APL hosts canonical Pluto-flyby imagery at higher res — upgrade target for future pass.

dragonfly._notes: Mission not yet launched (NET 2027). Limited imagery available. Curation pass when mission lands.
